info.name: Khatma BE - Quran
info.description: Quran Khatma progress. Authenticated requests use the access token from the Auth collection. Requests are available to Khatma members; invalid ids or Juz numbers return 400, unknown or non-Quran Khatmas return 404, non-members return 403, and unavailable Juz actions return 409.

item.name: Read all Juz states
item.description: Returns 30 ordered objects shaped as { juzNumber, status, claimedBy, claimedByName }. status is free, claimed, or completed; member-only.

item.name: Read current user's progress
item.description: Returns { completedJuz, selectedJuz } where selectedJuz contains only this user's claimed Juz numbers.

item.name: Claim a Juz
item.description: Atomically claims a free Juz for the current member. Returns null; an already claimed/completed Juz returns 409.

item.name: Release my Juz
item.description: Atomically releases a Juz claimed by the current member. Returns null; a Juz not held by the current member returns 409.

item.name: Complete my Juz
item.description: Atomically completes a Juz claimed by the current member. Completing the final Juz also marks the shared Khatma completed and sets completedAt. Returns null.
